pins.name: D14
pins.label: D14 (GPIO13)
pins.notes: SD_CARD_DETECT (also aliased D14) - onboard microSD card connector's card-presence-detect switch, with a weak external 220K pull-up per the vendor datasheet. digital_output/pwm_output dropped since driving this pin could contend with the socket's own switch state; digital_input retained since reading card presence is a genuine, safe, useful operation. Matches this repo's adafruit_feather_adalogger / solderparty_rp2350_stamp PIN_CARD_DETECT precedent.

pins.name: D18
pins.label: GPIO24 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED / LED_BUILTIN (D18 alias) - onboard user-programmable green LED. Confirmed present via ilabs.se's official datasheet ("This LED is connected to pin D18"). Active-high polarity is a cross-referenced inference: sibling board challenger_2040_wifi's own datasheet states "Active level: High" for the identical shared reference LED circuit reused across this iLabs product line, and sibling challenger_2040_nfc uses the identical GPIO24 pin for its own led_high-tagged LED. digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins; pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming.

pins.name: GPIO25
pins.label: GPIO25
pins.notes:
MCP79410 RTC's MFP (multi-function pin) / "PIN_RTC_INTERRUPT" per iLabs' own datasheet wording (a logical/documentation name only - no such macro exists in arduino-pico's actual pins_arduino.h, local or upstream). Onboard RTC chip's open-drain interrupt/alarm output, driven by the RTC and merely read by the RP2040. digital_output/pwm_output dropped since driving this pin from the RP2040 side would fight the RTC's own drive of the line; digital_input retained since reading the RTC's interrupt/alarm flag is a genuine, safe, useful operation. Matches this repo's wiznet_5100s_evb_pico INTn precedent (dedicated onboard interrupt line, input-only since chip-driven).
